fields.title: Fields
fields.description: HL7 field numbers to mask, per segment (e.g. {"PID": [3, 5]}).

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: JSON keys and XML element names masked wherever they appear.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: JSON and XML paths to mask (Patient.name, *.text.div, $.patient.ssn).

schema.title: PhiMaskingUpdate
schema.description:
The whole policy, validated by hand in the handler so a rejection comes
back as one readable 400 message rather than pydantic's 422 error list.
